purpose: Exploration candidates, not optimized or declared winners
unchanged: dynamic fixed-pivot flyweight mechanism and ramp
tip_mass_model: Add/remove concentrated hardware mass at the existing roller-centre station; preserve the reference arm/body moments. The reference tuning manifest identifies 0.250 kg tip hardware per flyweight.

competitors.label: Light weights + load reserve
competitors.intent: Candidate: higher engine working speed plus stronger secondary load response.

competitors.label: Moderate weights + axial reserve
competitors.intent: Candidate: combine modest working-speed change with greater spring-supported clamp.

competitors.label: Light weights + relaxed helix
competitors.intent: Candidate: higher engine speed with less aggressive torque sensitivity, supported by torsional preload.

competitors.label: Heavier weights + responsive helix
competitors.intent: Candidate: reconcile earlier primary closing with greater secondary torque sensitivity.

competitors.label: Light weights + softer primary preload
competitors.intent: Candidate: offset some engagement delay of lighter weights with lower opening-spring preload; this does not guarantee matched engagement.

competitors.label: Spring-supported climb candidate
competitors.intent: Candidate: moderately lighter weights, slightly steeper helix and increased axial reserve.

competitors.label: Premature-shift stress control
competitors.intent: Intentionally adverse hypothesis: early primary closing and weak secondary opposition may pull the engine down under load.

competitors.label: Late-engagement stress control
competitors.intent: Intentionally adverse hypothesis: weak centrifugal closing against high preload may delay engagement or maintain primary slip.

competitors.label: Weak-secondary stress control
competitors.intent: Intentionally adverse hypothesis: reduced axial and torsional spring support with weak torque feedback may expose contact limitations.

competitors.label: Light-tip flat-limit probe
competitors.intent: Reduce centrifugal closing while keeping the original spring; test whether full shift is reached on a much longer flat.

competitors.label: Very-light-tip flat-limit probe
competitors.intent: Larger single-knob mass reduction: distinguish persistent under-shifting from merely late high-ratio arrival.

competitors.label: Extreme light-tip control
competitors.intent: Deliberately weak primary centrifugal action; may shift only partially or slip rather than support competitive operation.

competitors.label: High primary-preload probe
competitors.intent: A different mechanism for delayed or incomplete upshift: greater primary opening-spring opposition.

competitors.label: High secondary-twist probe
competitors.intent: Strong spring-supported secondary closing force without changing the motion ratio.

competitors.label: Load-holding combination probe
competitors.intent: Combine lighter tips and stronger secondary opposition; compare its flat behavior to single-knob probes.

description: Original 32 entrants, unchanged, plus six deliberately under-shift-biased probes; no new mechanisms or boundary changes.
